question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Fostering the Use of Technology to Uphold Regulatory Effectiveness in Supervision Act (H R 8278)
bill_title: Fostering the Use of Technology to Uphold Regulatory Effectiveness in Supervision Act
plain_language: This bill orders federal banking regulators to study whether their technology can supervise firms in real time and whether buying new systems is slowed by procurement rules. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Main Street Act (H R 6955)
plain_language: This bill lessens and otherwise modifies banking regulations, including those regarding institution formation, supervision by federal financial regulators, and bank merger requirements. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — Main Street Act (H R 6955)
plain_language: H.R. 6955 (Main Street Capital Access Act) lessens and otherwise modifies banking regulations, including those regarding institution formation, supervision by federal financial regulators, and bank merger requirements. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Passage — Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act (H R 1181)
plain_language: This bill prohibits payment card networks from using merchant codes that distinguish firearms retailers from general-merchandise retailers or sporting-goods retailers. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — TRIA Program Reauthorization Act (H R 7128)
plain_language: This bill reauthorizes the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program through 2034. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Financial Exploitation Prevention Act (H R 2478)
plain_language: This bill establishes procedures for delaying the redemption of certain securities if an investment company or agent believes that an older individual or an individual with certain impairments has been financially exploited. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — 25th Anniversary of 9/11 Commemorative Coin Act (H R 1993)
plain_language: This bill directs the Department of the Treasury to mint and issue coins to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks on the United States and the establishment of the National September 11 Memorial and Museum at the World Trade Center. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Community Bank Deposit Access Act (H R 5317)
bill_title: Community Bank Deposit Access Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill changes the treatment of certain types of deposits so they are no longer classified as brokered deposits. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — American Access to Banking Act (H R 4544)
plain_language: This bill requires federal financial regulators to review and streamline the application process for the formation of de novo, or new, depository institutions or credit unions. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Keeping Deposits Local Act (H R 3234)
plain_language: This bill increases the amount insured depository institutions may accept as reciprocal deposits. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
